target_customer: Direct to consumer and ecommerce brands needing custom packaging
problem: Small online brands struggled to design and order custom packaging because factories had high minimums and no digital ordering.
business_model: Packaging marketplace and software, margin on orders

founders.name: Jesse Genet
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; Wikipedia ties her to Shark Tank in 2015

founders.name: Steph Ango
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; CTO title per Homebrew

competitors.name: Packlane
competitors.funding_then: $4M from Draper Associates and Breakout Capital (listicle, undated)

technical_complexity.rationale: Software to quote and route orders across a factory network plus supply chain operations.

defensibility.rationale: Factory network and brand customer ordering history created moderate lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Narvar acquired Lumi in December 2021; Lumi served 700+ DTC brands.

market_need_then: DTC and ecommerce growth made branded packaging a visible gap; Lumi cites brands such as Parachute Home and Nutrafol.

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated brands share the name Lumi; coverage found was packaging trade press (The Dieline). Name origin not found.

outcome_analysis: Lumi rode DTC packaging demand to a $9M Series A in 2018 and 700+ brand customers, then sold to Narvar in December 2021. Price undisclosed. The exit rather than IPO suggests a solid but not venture scale outcome.
